Identified by hand on purpose. A VLM was tried on the same images and got
roughly half of them wrong — 2 as l_2, k as \kappa, a comma as an
apostrophe — and a wrong entry here is silent: it corrupts every formula
containing that glyph, in every topic, with nothing to show for it. The
table is small and permanent, so it is worth reading rather than guessing.
Only unambiguous glyphs are listed. The crops include a little of the
neighbouring characters, which makes some of the tail genuinely uncertain;
those are left out and stay U+FFFD, which the drafting stage treats as
'look at the crop'. Better to recover 60% exactly than 90% with errors.
Values are the base character. Whether an occurrence is a subscript or a
superscript is carried by the glyph's y-position in the page JSON, not here.
